jobs_results.title: Senior .NET Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior .NET Developer

Location: Madrid + relocation package available

Flexible work + benefits

Just English required

You will work in the Software Engineering division, which is in charge of creating and delivering enterprise-level software solutions, as a Senior Backend Developer. As a member of the skilled development team, you will actively participate in maintaining current functionality and developing new features to improve the product.

Responsibilities
• Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to evaluate requirements and convert them into scalable, effective software solutions that take integration, security, and performance into account.
• Exhibit technical leadership by actively taking part in the planning and creation of intricate system features, mentoring more junior team members, and making sure that coding standards are followed.
• Promote the application of best practices in software development, testing, and deployment to uphold a high level of code... quality and enable scalable and maintainable systems.
• Keep up with developments in the software engineering field, new technologies, and industry trends. Actively incorporate pertinent insights into the development process to improve the product that we offer.

Qualifications:
• Exhibits a high level of expertise in the dynamic world of igaming solutions while utilising the newest.NET Technologies (.NET Core, WebAPIs, Orleans) in the B2B software sector.
• Practical knowledge in event-driven microservices architecture, preferably with Microsoft Orleans' actor framework and Kafka, utilising a variety of communication ports such as REST, Events, and RPC.
• Thorough understanding of GIT Flow and source control, with a focus on version control best practices.
• JIRA experience is deemed beneficial; familiarity with tools that improve teamwork and project management is preferred.
• Track record of success in performance profiling, optimisation, and debugging, demonstrating a dedication to providing top-notch software solutions.
• Thorough knowledge of observability concepts and resources, including Grafana and Prometheus

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Senior de .NET / SQL
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete a nuestra emocionante travesía tecnológica! Somos una consultora tecnológica multinacional en pleno crecimiento, líder en proyectos nacionales e internacionales, y en solo 13 años hemos evolucionado para convertirnos en un equipo global de más de 7500 apasionados profesionales en más de 40 países.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Desarrollo Profesional Sin Límites: En nuestro equipo de Valencia, te espera un mundo de oportunidades. Ofrecemos un plan de carrera personalizado que te guiará hacia tus metas, junto con un generoso presupuesto de formación. Accede a más de 500 cursos en nuestro catálogo ACADEMY, que abarca desde habilidades de comunicación interpersonal hasta gestión de equipos y proyectos de vanguardia.
• Explora el Mundo: ¿Sueñas con una carrera internacional? En nuestra empresa, puedes hacerlo realidad. Abre tus horizontes y disfruta de oportunidades de movilidad internacional o explora diferentes departamentos y sectores para un crecimiento profesional inigualable.
•... Colaboración en Proyectos Innovadores: Únete a nuestro equipo especializado en tecnologías .NET y trabaja en proyectos emocionantes que utilizan las últimas tendencias de .NET y las mejores prácticas. Recibirás apoyo y formación de nuestros experimentados arquitectos de software y participarás en la toma de decisiones técnicas de arquitectura.
• Participación en Comunidad Tecnológica: No solo trabajamos, sino que también aprendemos juntos. Te proporcionamos acceso a nuestra plataforma de formación interna y te alentamos a asistir a eventos tecnológicos para mantenerte actualizado y conectado con la comunidad.

Habilidades Necesarias:
• Experiencia sólida en desarrollo con bases de datos ( T-SQL SQL SERVER)
• Conocimiento del ciclo de desarrollo de software
• Desarrollo software en ASP, Vb
• Experiencia en entornos de ERP

Habilidades Deseadas
• Programación web (Angular-REDUX, ASP.NET MVC, CSS, NET Core).
• Desarrollo de API REST
• Servicios PassS Azure
• Gestión de la configuración (Git, Pull Requests, Integración continua).
• HTML5, frameworks javascript, SQL Server
• Frameworks para desarrollo web services (WebAPI, WCF)
• Conocimiento de stack tecnológico: Mongo, Azure Event, Azure Function

Si eres un apasionado de la tecnología y estás listo para impulsar tu carrera en un ambiente dinámico y global, ¡esperamos conocerte pronto! Únete a nuestro equipo y sé parte de una comunidad de innovadores en constante crecimiento

jobs_results.title: .NET Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Share this job

We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack .NET Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing high-quality web applications using .NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and other modern web technologies. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining the frontend and backend of our web applications, ensuring that they are fast, responsive, and user-friendly.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain the frontend and backend of our web applications using .NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and other modern web technologies.
• Collaborate with designers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our web applications are fast, responsive, and user-friendly.
• Write clean, maintainable, and testable code.
• Optimize our web applications for maximum speed and scalability.
• Ensure that our web applications are accessible and meet the latest web standards.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest web development trends and... technologies.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
• At least 5 years of relevant experience developing web applications using .NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and other modern web technologies.
• Track record of building scalable solutions using Azure PaaS technology
• Experience with RESTful APIs and JSON and Entity Framework.
• Experience with Git and other version control systems.
• Experience with Azure DevOps a plus (Build Automation, Deployment Pipelines)
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Fluent in English

Apply now

Location Madrid, Spain

Barcelona, Spain Job type Full time Experience Management Job function IT, Telecom & Internet Contract Regular Publication date 2024-03-22 Reference number R0045618

jobs_results.title: Architect .Net Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native technology services company where innovation, design and engineering meet scale. We use some of the latest technologies in the digital and cognitive field to empower organizations in every aspect.

Right now, we are looking for .Net Developers to join our team at Globant!

You will get the chance to:
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Develop your career within an industry or multiple industries.
• Work in the city you want, and be nourished by cultural exchanges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.
• Be part of an agile pod. Driven by a culture of... self-regulated teamwork, each team -or POD- works directly with our customers with a full maturity path that evolves as they increase speed, quality and autonomy.

What will help you succeed:
• Believe and love what you do.
• Make "No’s" become "What ifs".
• Have imagination and you love innovating.
• Being flexible & goal oriented.
• Being capable of taking a step back to look at a bigger picture.
• Experience with Azure.
• Experience in application’s design using .Net frameworks.
• Solid knowledge using LINQ and Entity Framework (or other ORM).
• Experience in development and integration with RESTful APIs.
• Knowledge in SQL Server, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
• Experience with ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web API with C#.

At Globant we believe that an inclusive culture and a diverse environment makes us stronger. We encourage people to have an inclusive spirit as our global footprint expands. We seek to generate a place of inspiration and growth for everyone. A safe space, based on equity as a value, where everyone's careers can be promoted and developed in the same way. There is no innovation without diversity and there is no improvement without plurality.

Are you ready?

Job Segment: Developer, .NET, SQL, Database, Architecture, Technology, Engineering
